title: Christmas Dinner — Bishampton Villages Hall
body: Bishampton & District Gardening Club's Christmas dinner, from 7pm: a meal with fun, frivolity, quizzes and a sing-along. £29 per head. All welcome. To book, contact the club's chairman, Pete Chamberlain, on 01386 267492 or info@bishamptongardeningclub.org.uk.
